what: A MULTIMORPHING bitimbral synth: two complete parts, three ways to play them together, and a morph that glides between two versions of every sound. Ten engines with wavetables, twin filters, effects and a mod matrix. Macros and MIDI presets for Circuit Tracks and MPC/Force. Velocity, aftertouch.
author: OSCILL/R
sounds: own: the patches and multis made for DUELL

smk37.what: DUELL on the SMK-37: two complete parts on one screen, KNOB 1 to 4 for part 1 and KNOB 5 to 8 for part 2. The faders set each part's level and morph, the 16 pads play PERFORM effects, and the keys split between the parts. One build for each model: Pro, Elite and MKE-P37.
